newsitem.title: ITALY: Port conditions update - Italy - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Italy - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Trieste, Dec 20 - Due to ground subsidence at Margreth quay Porto Nogaro has been inoperative since Dec 18 by order of the harbour-master. Investigations by technical organisations as to the cause of the depressions are under way. Port operations will only resume after safety in all respects is guaranteed. Five vessels are idle.
